business.what_it_does: Company transmits bulk power, provides telecom services, and offers consultancy services in transmission, distribution, and telecom sectors.

segments.name: Transmission
segments.what: Transmits bulk power across different states of India.

segments.name: Consultancy
segments.what: Provides consultancy services in transmission, distribution, and telecom sectors.

segments.name: Telecom
segments.what: Leases point-to-point bandwidth using spare optical fibres.

business.mix_note: Revenue from any single customer does not equal or exceed 10% of total revenue.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Consolidated PAT increased to 15,928 crore for FY26 matching management's reported profit increase.
EBITDA dropped sharply to 5,303 crore in Mar 2026 (45% EBITDA margin) despite high historical cash conversions.
Gross fixed assets breached 3 lakh crore standing at 320,334 crore for FY26, confirming asset growth claims.

bull: Consolidated PAT increased by 3% to 15,928 crore for the year ending Mar 2026.
Strong 5y cash conversion of 2.25, with Mar 2026 operating cash flow at 40,935 crore.
Gross fixed assets stand high at over Rs. 3.25 lakh crore in Q1 FY27.
bear: Operating margin down 1500 bps over 3 years.
Mar 2026 quarterly EBITDA collapsed to 5,303 crore with EBITDA% falling to 45%.
Borrowings increased to 151,269 crore as of Sep 2026 with D/E at 1.42.
watch: FY27 capitalization guidance of Rs. 30,000 crore achievement status.
Borrowings trajectory against Sep 2026 level of 151,269 crore.
EBITDA margin recovery from Mar 2026 lows.
